# Qdrant — Qdrant for Startups

20% discount on Qdrant Cloud for the first year (12 months from acceptance), plus expert technical sessions and partner perks from Hugging Face, LlamaIndex and Airbyte.

## What you get

| | |
|---|---|
| **Type** | discount |
| **Amount** | The vendor publishes no figure |
| **Duration** | 12 months |
| **Expiry** | The discount is valid for 12 months from the date of acceptance and applies exclusively to our Cloud services billed through Qdrant (via Stripe). |


### Not covered

- agencies
- devshops
- billing through a marketplace
- previous participants in the Qdrant for Startups program

**Stages named by the vendor:** pre-seed, seed, series-a

### Where it is available

**The vendor publishes no geographic restriction.** That is not the same as
confirming it is available where you are — check their terms before applying.

### Notes

Vendor self-contradiction: the eligibility list states the flat requirement 'New user of Qdrant Cloud.', while a later FAQ states 'Yes, existing Qdrant customers are eligible to apply for the Startup Program if their cloud account was created within the last 30 days from the date of application.' The more conservative requirement (new user) is quoted in status/eligibility and new_customer_only is set true. No currency amount is published - the benefit is a percentage discount only.

## How to apply

| | |
|---|---|
| **Process** | self serve form |
| **Turnaround** | Applications are reviewed within 7-10 business days |
| **Partners** | Hugging Face, LlamaIndex, Airbyte |

**[Apply →](https://qdrant.tech/qdrant-for-startups/#form)**

### What they ask of you in return

- Provide a link to a live, functional website
- Add credit card details to the Qdrant account to utilize the discount
- Billing must be done directly with Qdrant (via Stripe), not through a marketplace
